CustomField.description: When ticked, a later successful call closes the open API issues of the same request. Outbound: a successful call with the same triggering record, service and request parameters marks every open issue of that request Resolved. Inbound: this also needs Idempotency Enabled. A request answered with a status from 200 to 299 marks Resolved the open issues of the earlier failed requests that the same user sent to this service with the same Idempotency-Key, whatever their body. A request without a key resolves nothing.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to close open API issues when the same request later succeeds. Outbound: a successful call for the same record, service and parameters. Inbound: also needs Idempotency Enabled; a success (status 200 to 299) with the same Idempotency-Key from the same user resolves the issues of the earlier failed requests.
CustomField.label: Resolve Issues
